subject: Independent FoldInteractive history finding: multi-anchor was tried and reverted
body: Independent source audit against main 413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace plus repo history. CONFIRMED current Alpha2: WallpaperAngleFeed owns one DEFAULT_DISPLAY 1x1 FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER accessibility-overlay token, polls it with sequenced sendWallpaperCommand, AngleReader accepts only matching FoldInteractive onCommand lines with isVisible=true and mCurrentAngle, and stale >2.5s only clearExternal() without anchor rebuild. IMPORTANT HISTORY: commit 58404d5 (Fold7 1.3.18-era path) explicitly anchored every exposed 1080x2520/1968x2184 Fold7 display and polled every anchor; commit 96788a7 then reverted to one DEFAULT_DISPLAY because field diagnostics said the secondary anchor was repeatedly removed/re-added during Samsung topology commits and correlated with cover-panel black flashes. Therefore do NOT simply restore dynamic all-display anchors. Current upstream joeconsorti/duo-fold-live LiveAngles at 8ca4371 uses a primary anchor plus a secondary anchor only while dualActive and sends the same command through both, suggesting stable overlap can work when lifecycle is controlled. Strong direction: test non-churning secondary-anchor ownership (attach once on a proven/stable secondary route, retain through the transition, detach only on definitive removal/lease end) or a bounded stale-recovery anchor; separate presence from churn. Official Android docs confirm sendWallpaperCommand is scoped by caller windowToken and WallpaperService can have multiple engines in multi-display environments. If Agent01 direct sensor succeeds, this entire wallpaper telemetry path should be deleted rather than hardened. No production writes.
